description: Use for "which planets are retrograde" questions. For Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto on a date, returns the phase (preShadow, retrograde, postShadow or direct), the sign, the current or next cycle's moments, cazimi-day (Mercury, Venus) and opposition-day (Mars through Pluto) flags, and one sentence naming the retrograde planets and when each stations direct. Times are UTC, to the minute, from the ephemeris (JPL DE421, 2025–2030). This is astronomical timing, not a horoscope.

date.description: Date to check as YYYY-MM-DD (read as 12:00 UTC). Defaults to now.
